description: This file defines the 'Module' entity class for the OrangeHRM system using Doctrine ORM annotations, mapping the class to the 'ohrm_module' database table. It includes properties for id, name, display name, and status, along with getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Entity class representing a system module with properties for ID, name, display name, and status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the module.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the module.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the module.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the module.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the operational status of the module.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the operational status of the module.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the module.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the display name of the module.
